title_zh: 嫦娥七号器箭组合体完成垂直转运
title_en: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft and Rocket Assembly Completes Vertical Transport
summary_zh: 8月19日，嫦娥七号器箭组合体垂直转运至发射区，计划近日择机实施发射。
summary_en: On August 19, the Chang'e-7 spacecraft and rocket assembly was vertically transported to the launch area, with launch planned in the coming days.
body_zh:
新华社快讯：嫦娥七号计划近日择机实施发射，器箭组合体垂直转运至发射区。
